recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The source is correct after the RequestGroup-to-RequestOrchestration rename, and adding RequestGroup-named or redundant GuidanceResponse wording would make the current build less accurate.
issue_request: FHIR-12301 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core GuidanceResponse change request to decompose GuidanceResponse by moving the action-to-be-performed elements into a new RequestGroup resource usable for decision-support responses and optional CarePlan components.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite SVN #10094, #10095, and #10096. Git history maps these to commits that added RequestGroup, removed the superseded ActivityGroup resource, and removed GuidanceResponse.action elements from GuidanceResponse source and examples.
additional_context: FHIR-24619 later renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration, and source/fhir.ini records RequestGroup as a removed/renamed resource mapped to RequestOrchestration. Later GuidanceResponse decisions, including FHIR-14179 and FHIR-37891, kept GuidanceResponse as a response container and refined GuidanceResponse.result rather than reintroducing inline action elements.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Active build-scope source has GuidanceResponse and RequestOrchestration resources; GuidanceResponse.result references RequestOrchestration and other request resources, while RequestOrchestration.action contains the proposed-actions backbone.

related_jiras.note: Renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration, explaining the current resource name that carries the split-out action backbone.
Reversed GuidanceResponse deprecation and kept GuidanceResponse as a response container that can point to request/action results.
Expanded GuidanceResponse.result to 0..* and request-resource targets while preserving the separated action model.
